payload.title: The email that became the rules
payload.description: Ryan-requested draft following discussion of OpenAI’s 25 September 2026 self-replicating prompt injection report. Reporting angle: malicious text travels in legitimate replies; memory could preserve the instruction as standing procedure. Keep demonstrated transmission, independently tested memory persistence, and the hypothetical combined email worm distinct. One documented laboratory scene; no invented victim or claimed live outbreak. Board draft only.
